title: Kicho Net

note.p: The fourth basic form opens the hands: a knife-hand outer block in back stance before each punch on the side lines, and three double knife-hand blocks in back stance on the centre line, the block that Taegeuk Sam Jang and Sa Jang build on. Basic forms are not set by the Kukkiwon and every school has its own version; this page draws the version shown by Park's Tae Kwon Do.

footer: 20 movements on the same I-shaped line as Kicho Hana: the first line (1–4) is walked again at the end (17–20). The kihaps are on 8 and 16. Finish with Baro: bring the left foot back and turn to face ga in the ready stance, on the spot where you started.

moves.desc: Stand at na facing ga, feet parallel and one foot-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn 90° left toward da¹, stepping the left foot into a back stance with the left foot forward. Left knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward ra¹, moving the right foot into a back stance with the right foot forward. Right knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Turn 90° left toward ga, stepping the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a back stance with the right foot forward. Double knife-hand block.
Step forward into a back stance with the left foot forward. Double knife-hand block.
Step forward into a back stance with the right foot forward. Double knife-hand block. Kihap.
Turn 270° left toward ra³, moving the left foot into a back stance with the left foot forward. Left knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward da³, moving the right foot into a back stance with the right foot forward. Right knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Turn 90° left toward na, stepping the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a back stance with the right foot forward. Double knife-hand block.
Step forward into a back stance with the left foot forward. Double knife-hand block.
Step forward into a back stance with the right foot forward. Double knife-hand block. Kihap.
Turn 270° left toward da¹, moving the left foot into a back stance with the left foot forward. Left knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward ra¹, moving the right foot into a back stance with the right foot forward. Right knife-hand outer block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
